title: Eternal Doom Trap
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji placed the last chess piece, a cold voice emerged from the shadows—"Chen Ji, when will you give me the answer you owe?" Ye Qing's form slowly materialized from the Void, a dangerous smile playing on his lips, a blood-stained token clutched in his hand.

text.content: The three-day deadline hung like a sword over his head. Chen Ji sat alone in the dilapidated Servants' Quarters, the candlelight flickering, casting his tranquil face in alternating light and shadow. The Tianji Record Fragment was pressed beneath his palm—the ancient page bearing the weight of fate now burned slightly hot, as if urging or warning. He closed his eyes, and his mind rapidly flashed through the code names and deployment positions of all hidden agents. Three years of groundwork, dozens of chess pieces—today was the moment to test their worth. "Eternal doom..." he murmured these four words, a cold, fierce curve forming at the corner of his mouth. "Everyone, it's time to move." The words fell, and outside the window, a night crow startled, its wingbeats dissolving into the thick darkness.

dialogue.content: (Sealing three copper coins engraved with hidden patterns into bamboo tubes, bound with red cord) A moment later, the entire 'Mute' generation of the Tianji Bureau was activated. Tell them—the Eternal Doom Plan, First Layer—commence.

text.content: The bamboo tubes shot through the air, silently merging into the night. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back at the window, his gaze piercing through the layers of rooftops, falling upon the abandoned forest clearing called "Fallen Leaf Slope" at Tianqing Sect's outer perimeter. When he purchased this land for ten taels of silver three years ago, everyone mocked his foolishness—now, thirty zhang beneath the surface, a precisely operating intelligence hub had long been established. The hidden agents called it the "Ant Nest," meaning to accumulate from many small things, ants devouring elephants. The activation signal was spreading along secret channels in all directions at a speed beyond ordinary imagination.

dialogue.content: (Fingertips tapping the table lightly, rhythm like a heartbeat) Any movements from the eyes within Xuanwu Sect? How far has the Crown Prince's Manor's tendrils reached? And the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path... has Ye Qing's contact replied?

text.content: Before the words even finished, a pitch-black carrier pigeon crashed through the window paper, a slender tube bound to its leg containing a scroll thin as a cicada's wing. Chen Ji unfolded it carefully, his brow slightly rising—an urgent report from the Crown Prince's Manor insider: among the Crown Prince's retainers was an "Imperial Chess Attendant" who had begun secretly investigating the Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple registry three days ago, and Chen Ji's name was clearly written on that roster. More intriguing was that behind this Imperial Chess Attendant seemed to stand the shadow of an Elder from Xuanwu Sect.

dialogue.content: (Bringing the silk scroll close to the candle flame, watching the words turn to ash in the firelight) Interesting. Crown Prince, Xuanwu Sect, Imperial Chess Attendant... this group gathering together actually saves me considerable effort. Only this investigation came too quickly—it seems as if someone deliberately muddied the waters, waiting to see how I respond.

text.content: Chen Ji crushed the ashes, wiping the charcoal residue casually on his robe's hem. Unhurriedly, he took a copper coin from his chest—the obverse carved with "Heaven and Earth," the reverse covered in dense tiny characters—cipher symbols only he could decipher. The coin turned between his fingers, each pause representing the issuance of a command. Outside the Servants' Quarters, in the seemingly ordinary night, several silhouettes had silently altered their trajectories, heading toward their designated targets.

choice.prompt: With Crown Prince forces intervening early, Chen Ji needed to reassess the situation within limited time. How should he handle this intelligence?

choices.description: Since the enemy has come knocking voluntarily, why not use this connection to reverse-infiltrate the Crown Prince's Manor, planting a nail in the enemy's very heart? High risk but stunning rewards.
choices.visible_reward: Crown Prince's Manor intelligence channels unlocked
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, would simultaneously offend the Imperial Court and Xuanwu Sect

text.content: Chen Ji coldly laughed, pen tip dipped in blood, writing four characters on another silk scroll: "Invite the guest into the jar." He would use Chen Ji, this "waste," as bait to lure out the Crown Prince's Manor's greater ambitions—while he himself hid in the shadows, laughing as this bunch of fools who thought themselves hunters tore each other apart. The carrier pigeon spread its wings, once again vanishing into the night sky.

choices.description: Immediately sever all contact points related to the Crown Prince's Manor, sacrificing some hidden agents to purchase overall security. Conservative but safe, avoiding alerting the enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Loss of two mid-level hidden agents

text.content: Chen Ji contemplated briefly, then flipped the copper coin to show "Heaven and Earth" on the front, flicking it gently toward the southeast. The coin landed with a crisp ring, and he murmured: "Qing Que, Hui Lu, immediately destroy all related items, evacuate your original posts, and find safe places to lie in ambush." Sacrificing two chess pieces for the cleanliness of the entire game—this calculation, he knew better than anyone.

choices.description: Outwardly sever contact while actually going underground, simultaneously accelerating layout on another track, forming two parallel intelligence networks—one overt, one covert. Complex but comprehensive.
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high operational difficulty, requiring simultaneous processing of multiple intelligence streams

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and meditated for a moment. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm grew slightly warm—he had used his Foresight Ability once more, capturing a hidden thread of clues within the blurred future visions. When he opened his eyes, a sharp gleam flickered deep within his pupils. "Interesting... Since you all want to watch a show, then I'll perform for you. The play above ground and underground will begin simultaneously." He picked up his brush and wrote entirely different directives on two pieces of silk.

Having arranged everything, Chen Ji was about to use the cover of night to personally oversee operations at Fallen Leaves Slope. Suddenly, light but utterly undisguised footsteps sounded outside the door. That rhythmic pace was all too familiar to him—unhurried, each step striking like a drumbeat, carrying the unique pride and pressure of an Inner Disciple. Chen Ji's expression subtly changed. He swiftly swept the silk fragments and special ink into his sleeves, grabbed a broom, and assumed the posture of someone doing routine cleaning. The door swung open, moonlight pouring in, revealing a figure cold as frost—Su Qingyao.

dialogue.content: (Standing at the doorway with hands clasped behind back, eyes sharp as swords, examining Chen Ji up and down) Chen Junior, the Servants' Quarters leaving doors open at night—you have quite refined tastes. For the Sect Competition in three days, instead of properly preparing, this 'waste' disciple is sneaking around here... Are you waiting for someone, or doing something unspeakable?

text.content: Su Qingyao's words cut like ice blades. Chen Ji, however, merely gave a simple, honest smile. He leaned the broom against the wall, wearing an expression of being genuinely flattered: "Senior Su flatters me too much. Junior here is afraid of embarrassing myself if I lose the competition, so I wouldn't dare practice swordsmanship during the day. I can only secretly practice my sweeping skills at night..." As he spoke, his gaze couldn't help but glance past Su Qingyao—this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow came alone at night without any attendants, which in itself was an extremely unusual signal. How much did she actually know?

dialogue.content: (Taking a step forward, the distance suddenly closing, her tone turning colder) Chen Ji, do you take me for a three-year-old? That carrier pigeon flying out your window just now—I saw it clearly. And those things hidden in your sleeves, would you like me to pull them out and show the whole sect?

text.content: Su Qingyao's advance made Chen Ji's back tighten slightly, but he didn't retreat. He lifted his head. On that face, usually dull and simple, a hint of calm smile appeared for the first time—that smile made Su Qingyao's heart skip a beat. It was as if she wasn't seeing that bullied waste servant, but a chess master controlling the entire game. But it lasted only a moment. The smile receded like the tide, replaced once more by a timid appearance: "Senior Sister... what exactly do you want?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao pressed relentlessly closer. Chen Ji must make a response. Continue pretending ignorance to the end, or reveal partial truth to stabilize her?

choices.description: Reveal part of the plan but conceal the core strategy. Use retreat to advance, gaining her temporary trust. Present the image of a 'reluctantly coerced' victim to earn sympathy.
choices.risk_hint: She may follow the clues to uncover more truths

dialogue.content: (Sighing deeply, his expression bitter) Since Senior Sister has already seen through it, Junior won't hide the truth from you. During the competition in three days, someone wants to kill me. That carrier pigeon was... sent by my family elders to protect me. Although my Chen family has declined, our ancestors once flourished and left behind some... self-protection measures. That's all there is to it.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶开始怀疑陈机身份

choices.description: No longer passively explaining, but instead pointing out Su Qingyao's true purpose for coming alone at night. Use attack as defense to put her on the back foot.
choices.visible_reward: Gain control of the conversation's initiative
choices.risk_hint: Significantly increased risk of relationship breakdown

dialogue.content: (Gazing directly into Su Qingyao's eyes, his smile unchanged) Senior Sister travels alone at night, without attendants, and comes straight to the Servants' Quarters to find a 'waste' junior... Junior would like to ask, are you worried about me, or watching me? Or perhaps... is the person behind you also interested in the chess game three days from now?

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶意识到陈机不简单

choices.description: Abandon verbal attacks and counterattacks. Instead, show a vulnerable side. Move Su Qingyao with genuine emotion, laying groundwork for future cooperation.
choices.visible_reward: Greatly increase goodwill, may unlock side quests

dialogue.content: (His expression suddenly dimmed, lowering his gaze) Senior Sister... you're right. I am indeed doing something unspeakable. But it's not something harmful—it's... self-rescue. I've lived in this sect for three years, treated as trash and stepped on by others for three years. Do you know how I fall asleep every night? I'm afraid that if I close my eyes, I'll never wake up again.

text.content: As Chen Ji's words fell, silence descended upon the room. Su Qingyao narrowed her eyes slightly, noticing a change in this man's gaze—it was no longer the timidity and evasion typical of thetrashjunior brother, but a desperate light that erupted when driven to the wall. She suddenly recalled the day three years ago when this frail youth knelt at the sect gate, refusing to beg for mercy despite other disciples beating him. Back then she only thought him spineless; now, upon reflection... that was clearly forbearance.

dialogue.content: (After a long silence, his tone softened yet remained sharp) Chen Ji, I don't care what scheme you're orchestrating, but there's one thing you must remember—the Sect Competition three days from now, the old Sect Master will personally preside. He is... very interested in you. This interest makes me very uncomfortable. If you truly have means of self-protection, you'd better bring them all out in these three days. Don't die at an inopportune moment.

text.content: Lin Yuan's name struck like a bucket of cold water poured over Chen Ji's head. On the surface, he maintained his grateful posture, but within, monstrous waves were already crashing. He knew Lin Yuan harbored hostility toward him, yet he hadn't expected it to reach a degree that even Su Qingyao could detect. What made him even more vigilant was—why would Su Qingyao specifically come to warn him? Was she merely curious, or had she... already chosen a side?

Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a moment, seemingly searching for any flaws, but she only saw a face full of fear and gratitude. She snorted coldly, turned to leave, but paused at the door: "By the way, something I forgot to tell you—when I was patrolling the mountain tonight, I discovered traces of Demonic Path disciples at the foot of Duanhun Cliff in the northern part of the sect. That cliff face... was the crime scene of your Chen family's extermination three years ago." Before her words even finished, she had vanished into the night like a startled swan, leaving only a room of cold fragrance and moonlight scattered across the ground.

dialogue.content: (When the footsteps had completely faded, Chen Ji slowly straightened up, the mask of fear being peeled away to reveal the icy true countenance beneath) Duanhun Cliff... the Demonic Path... interesting. Su Qingyao ah Su Qingyao, this visit of yours—were you probing me, or delivering intelligence?

text.content: Chen Ji paced to the window with hands clasped behind his back. Moonlight rendered half his face pale as paper. Su Qingyao's words were like a stone dropped into his heart, stirring layer upon layer of ripples. He had never truly let go of the Chen family extermination case three years ago—and now with the Demonic Path reappearing at Duanhun Cliff, was it coincidence, or was someone deliberately drawing his attention? He drew a deep breath, his fingertips once again touching the warm copper coin against his chest, murmuring softly: "Through countless calamities... let the first layer begin with uncovering the secrets of Duanhun Cliff."

Just then, a诡异的 black mist seeped through the window cracks, coiling around Chen Ji's wrist like a living creature. The black mist was ice-cold, carrying an aura so familiar it made his heart race—Ye Qing. The signature technique of the Demonic Holy Sect. Instead of panic, his lips curved slightly, as if he had been waiting for this moment. Within the black mist, a graceful silhouette flickered, eventually forming the outline of a woman in black纱robes—precisely the Demonic Holy Saint Ye Qing.

dialogue.content: (Amid swirling black mist, Ye Qing's voice was cold as frigid wind from the Nine Netherworlds) Chen Ji, I kept my promise to conceal the Tianji Record's aura for you, but you should know—if I do this too often, the Holy Sect will notice. When will you give me the answer you owe me?

text.content: Ye Qing's appearance filled this dilapidated servants' quarters with an indescribable and ambiguous tension. Chen Ji looked at her—this Holy Saint of the Demonic Path, rumored to kill without hesitation, yet now bearing traces of fatigue and anxiety, nothing like the invincible legend. He mused internally: it seemed the Holy Sect's control over her had begun to backfire; otherwise, she wouldn't be so desperate. Good—the more desperate, the easier to become the blade in his hand.

Chen Ji unhurriedly poured a cup of cold tea, pushing it before Ye Qing: "Ye Holy Maiden's 'Demonic Path Mist' did indeed help me greatly; I remember this favor. However, the answer you want involves broad implications and can't be explained in a few words. How about this—the Sect Competition three days from now, if you can help me accomplish one thing, I'll tell you the complete version of that prophecy. How about it?" As he spoke, a meaningful smile curved at the corner of his lips. "This matter benefits you as well."

dialogue.content: (She took the cold tea but did not drink, her narrow eyes dangerously narrowing) Chen Ji, you'd better pray every word you speak is worthy of your life. Three days... I only give you three days. If it's still empty promises after three days, your "trash" persona won't be sustainable.

text.content: Ye Qing's figure gradually dissolved within the black mist. Before departing, she suddenly looked back, casting a meaningful glance at Chen Ji: "By the way, I forgot to tell you—the Holy Sect has recently been searching for a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' reportedly connected to your Chen family lineage. If you discover any interesting clues, remember to share them with me." As her voice faded, the black mist completely dispersed, leaving only a room of cold moonlight and Chen Ji's abruptly constricted pupils. Chen Nian... his younger sister, the one taken by the Holy Sect... could the Holy Sect be searching for her too?

Chen Ji stood alone before the window, his shadow stretched long by the moonlight. The news from Ye Qing was like another sword hanging over his head—the three-day deadline hadn't even passed, yet new stakes had already been placed on the gambling table. The Crown Prince's mansion, Xuanwu Sect, the old Sect Master Lin Yuan, the Demonic Holy Sect... and the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' sought by the Holy Sect—his missing sister Chen Nian. All clues were converging toward one direction—the Sect Competition three days from now would be the first move in his 万劫不复chess game, and possibly the turning point of his fate. He slowly closed his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm pulsed warmly, as if reminding him: every glimpse of the future comes at a price. And how much Heavenly Fate did he have left to squander?
